name: blacksmith
description: Blacksmith for Claude Code: plain explanations, a confidence % on options, a cross-check by a different model, model and effort per kind of task, and a compact rule. Plus an optional pull-request module, pr-mod.

plugins.name: blacksmith
plugins.description: Five small things for Claude Code: plain explanations, a confidence % on every option, a cross-check by a different model, model and effort per kind of task, and a compact rule.

plugins.name: pr-mod
plugins.description: Optional pull-request view: a pane lists the repo's open PRs with CI and merge state, and merges, updates a branch or sends a fix prompt; a band line above the prompt counts them. A plugin module; needs a Claude Code build with plugin modules and the gh CLI.
